summary: Yadi, becoming an LGBTQ advocate is a great "do something" project for #edu106. You video skills grew so much. Do not worry if you did not gravitate towards HTML, you must pick your pathways. So glad you want to start a YouTube channel. Good Luck!!
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Yadi, becoming an LGBTQ advocate is a great "do something" project for #edu106. You video skills grew so much. Do not worry if you did not gravitate towards HTML, you must pick your pathways. So glad you want to start a YouTube channel. Good Luck!!
